recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結結構被大量背靠背、大小相近、邊界模糊的結節取代，結節間只剩狹窄的淡粉紅色間隔，外套區不明顯、也看不到極性（明暗帶），呈濾泡性淋巴瘤的結節型生長；但第 3a 級需要高倍計數中心母細胞，本圖倍率無法判定分級。
features: Effacement of nodal architecture by closely packed, back-to-back nodules of similar size
Nodules poorly demarcated with attenuated or absent mantle zones
Loss of germinal center polarization (no dark/light zones) and absence of tingible-body macrophage 'starry-sky'
Narrow pale interfollicular areas with small vessels
Cytologic grading (centroblasts per HPF) not assessable at this low magnification
describe_en: Low-power H&E section of lymph node shows architectural effacement by numerous closely packed, back-to-back neoplastic follicles of relatively uniform size with attenuated mantle zones and compressed interfollicular regions. The follicles lack polarization and a starry-sky pattern of tingible-body macrophages. Cytologic detail is insufficient at this magnification to count centroblasts, so grading requires high-power evaluation (grade 3A: >15 centroblasts per HPF with centrocytes still present). The architecture is consistent with follicular lymphoma, reported in this case as grade 3A.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles vary in size and shape, have well-formed mantle zones, polarization, tingible-body macrophages and are BCL2-negative in germinal centers.

ddx.dx: Follicular large B-cell lymphoma (former FL grade 3B)
ddx.vs: Grade 3B/FLBL shows solid sheets of centroblasts without residual centrocytes, which requires high-power assessment, and may be BCL2/CD10-negative.

ddx.dx: Nodal marginal zone lymphoma with follicular colonization
ddx.vs: MZL shows interfollicular/perifollicular pale monocytoid cells colonizing follicles, with CD10-/BCL6- neoplastic cells and residual CD10+ germinal center remnants.
Nodular MCL consists of monotonous small centrocyte-like cells without centroblasts and is cyclin D1/SOX11-positive.
